infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Giri Raksha uses your location to alert you of nearby landslide risks and to geo-tag hazard reports.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Giri Raksha uses your camera to capture evidence of slope cracks, rockfalls, and road blockages.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Giri Raksha to determine your location for localized landslide risk alerts.

plugins.photosPermission: The app needs access to your photos to attach evidence to hazard reports.
